- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained that harder stones like marble and granite require more skill and can be more challenging for beginners.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided a list of online resources and classes for learning stone carving, including YouTube channels, Udemy, Skillshare, Stone Carving Academy, community colleges, art schools, local guilds, and books/DVDs on stone carving.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant emphasized the importance of safety when working with stone carving, recommending protective gear and a well-ventilated area.
